lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Ошибки списков формы локализуются вместо имени строки
value.meaning: Missing column, vanished selected row and empty row list show the corresponding localized human explanation rather than literal R.string text. Existing row selection, controls, callback and Save behavior are unchanged.
value.value_origin: Legacy FormBuilderModifyAttributesActivity fillTable/askForRow validation branch -> integer R.string Toast overload -> owned RU/EN resource. These are dynamic form paths, not declared XML widgets.
value.units: Human-readable localized text; no coordinates, CRS, server-body units or technical status dump.
updates: Existing operation lifecycle decides when a dialog/notification/progress message is delivered. A displayed explanation is separate from remote ACK, durable save or full-project completion.
actions: Read the cause and suggested next action; retry through the existing operation only after the reported condition changes.
conditions: The existing Activity route is preserved; no new field validation, business defaults, schema or draft migration.
value.saved_state: No new persistent error journal, automatic resend, saved-state migration or server mutation is introduced. Existing local edits/recovery and cancellation ownership remain separate contracts.
expectations: Each of three invalid technical list cases displays the exact owned resource, while valid-row control keeps its former behavior.
unknowns: Reflection/Robolectric cases cover actual private method text branches only; no full Activity lifecycle, real form/database, Save or device large-font acceptance.
